title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea
title_original: 국립해양생물자원관의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Procedures, Etc. for Acceptance of Donated Money and Property)
(1) Where the National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea (hereinafter referred to as the “Institute”) receives a donation of money or other property from an individual, corporation, or organization pursuant to Article 11 (3) of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), it shall issue a receipt to the donor: Provided, That it need not issue a receipt where the donation is anonymous or the donor cannot be identified.
(2) Where a donor under paragraph (1) designates a purpose for the money or other property donated (hereinafter referred to as “donated money and property”), the Institute shall use it solely for that purpose: Provided, That where there is a special reason making it difficult to use it for the purpose designated by the donor, the Institute may use it for another purpose with the donor’s consent.
(3) The Institute shall keep books concerning the status of acceptance and the actual use, etc. of donated money and property and make them available for inspection by donors.
(4) The Institute shall establish a separate account for managing monetary donations.

Article 3 (Submission of Business Plans, Etc.)
(1) To obtain approval of a business plan and budget pursuant to the former part of Article 12 (2) of the Act, the Director of the Institute (hereinafter referred to as the “Director”) shall submit the business plan and budget for the following business year to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries by November 30 of each year.
(2) To obtain approval of amendments to a business plan and budget pursuant to the latter part of Article 12 (2) of the Act, the Director shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries documents stating the details of and reasons for the amendments, together with the business plan and budget reflecting the amendments.

Article 4 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts)
Pursuant to Article 12 (3) of the Act, the Director shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries a business performance report and a statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure accounts for each fiscal year, accompanied by the following documents:
1. Financial statements for the relevant fiscal year (including a written audit opinion from a certified public accountant or an accounting firm under Article 23 of the Certified Public Accountant Act) and their accompanying documents;
2. A comparative table of the business plan for the relevant fiscal year and its implementation results;
3. A copy of the minutes of the board of directors concerning its resolution on the statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure accounts;
4. Other documents necessary to clarify the details of the settlement of accounts.

Article 5 (Application for Approval of Borrowing Funds)
Where the Institute intends to obtain approval for long-term borrowing of funds pursuant to Article 13 of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval of borrowing funds to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by the following documents:
1. A document stating the lender, reasons for borrowing, borrowing terms, and amount to be borrowed;
2. A document stating the method and deadline for repayment of the borrowed funds;
3. A document stating other matters necessary for borrowing and repaying the funds.

Article 6 (Requests for Secondment of Public Officials and Related Matters)
(1) Where, pursuant to Article 15(1) of the Act, the Director intends to obtain the approval of the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries to request that the head of a relevant administrative agency or research institution second public officials or other personnel belonging to that agency or institution, the Director shall submit a request for approval of secondment specifying the following matters to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries:
1. The reasons for requesting the secondment;
2. The period of secondment;
3. The number of persons to be seconded;
4. The fields of expertise and qualifications required of the personnel to be seconded.
(2) Public officials and other personnel seconded to the Institute shall comply with the service regulations and other rules prescribed by the Director during the period of secondment.
(3) The Institute may pay allowances to public officials and other personnel seconded pursuant to Article 15 of the Act in accordance with the criteria prescribed by the Institute's articles of incorporation: Provided, That allowances paid to seconded public officials shall not exceed the criteria specified in the following categories: <Amended on July 26, 2017>
1. For State public officials: The criteria prescribed by the Minister of Personnel Management pursuant to Article 41(8) of the Decree on the Appointment of Public Officials;
2. For local public officials: The criteria prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety pursuant to Article 27-2(6) of the Decree on the Appointment of Local Public Officials.

Article 7 (Conducting Operational Evaluations)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall conduct an operational evaluation under Article 16(2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "operational evaluation") every 3 years.
(2) The criteria for operational evaluations shall be as follows:
1. Evaluation of the Institute's management conditions: The degree of responsible management and operational efficiency, the appropriateness of budget, organizational, and human resources management, etc.;
2. Evaluation of survey and research activities concerning marine biological resources: The extent to which the research infrastructure has been expanded, the results of the operation of survey and research projects, etc.;
3. Evaluation of services to the public in connection with the operation of the Institute: The levels of customer satisfaction and service impact perceived by the public, achievements in improving services, etc.
(3) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intends to conduct an operational evaluation, the Minister shall prepare evaluation guidelines specifically setting out the basic direction, criteria, scope, schedule, and other matters concerning the operational evaluation and notify the Institute of such guidelines no later than 3 months before the date of the operational evaluation.

Article 8 (Criteria for Imposing Administrative Fines)
The criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 23(1) of the Act shall be as specified in the Annex.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 26189, April 7, 2015>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on April 16, 2015.

Article 2 (Repeal of Other Statutes)
The Regulations on the Committee for the Establishment of the National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea are repealed.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 28211, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That amendments under Article 8 of the Addenda to Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (309) Omitted.

(310) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea is partially amended as follows:
In Article 6 (3) 2, "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" shall be replaced by "Minister of the Interior and Safety."

(311) through (388) Omitted.
